In the year 2008, the total GDP (current US$) of the world was 64,311,729,364,641.3.

The country with the highest GDP (current US$) was 🇺🇸[United States](/economy/united-states/gdp-current-us), with a total of 14,769,857,911,000. Closely followed by 🇯🇵[Japan](/economy/japan/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 5,106,679,115,127.3, and 🇨🇳[China](/economy/china/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 4,667,346,414,521.95 recorded.

The country with the lowest annual GDP (current US$) was 🇹🇻[Tuvalu](/economy/tuvalu/gdp-current-us) with only 31,874,434.858 . Followed by 🇳🇷[Nauru](/economy/nauru/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 37,602,264.731, and 🇲🇭[Marshall Islands](/economy/marshall-islands/gdp-current-us) with 146,600,000.

The geographic region with the highest GDP (current US$) in 2008 was [Early-demographic dividend](/economy/early-demographic-dividend/gdp-current-us) with a total of 7,461,798,613,306.43. Closely followed by [East Asia & Pacific (IDA & IBRD countries)](/economy/east-asia-pacific-ida-ibrd-countries/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) 6,054,648,571,433.55, and [Euro area](/economy/euro-area/gdp-current-us) with 14,295,718,485,782.5 for the year.

When devided into income groups we can see that [High income groups](/economy/high-income/gdp-current-us) had the highest GDP (current US$) of 48,511,546,178,932.7. While the lowest GDP (current US$) was recorded by [Upper middle income groups](/economy/upper-middle-income/gdp-current-us) where the GDP (current US$) was only 12,105,099,178,344.4.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

This is an alphabetical **list of countries by past and projected [gross domestic product](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gross_domestic_product "Gross domestic product") (nominal)** as ranked by the IMF. Figures are based on official [exchange rates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exchange_rate "Exchange rate"), not on the [purchasing power parity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purchasing_power_parity "Purchasing power parity") (PPP) methodology. Values are given in millions of [United States dollars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_dollar "United States dollar") (USD) and have not been adjusted for inflation. These figures have been taken from the [International Monetary Fund](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Monetary_Fund "International Monetary Fund")'s World Economic Outlook (WEO) Database (April 2026 edition) and/or other sources.[[1]](#cite_note-IMF_Data-1)

For older GDP trends, see [List of regions by past GDP (PPP)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_regions_by_past_GDP_(PPP) "List of regions by past GDP (PPP)").
